facts.statement: The fuzz entry calls md_html with fuzz-derived parser flags, renderer flags, and the remaining input bytes.
Inputs shorter than two unsigned words return early. A finite route can put MD_FLAG_SPOILERS (0x10000) in the first word and ||text|| in the remaining bytes.

evidence.dependency_reason: Defines the spoiler flag value and paired-pipe syntax used by the route.

facts.statement: The after-source contract recognizes ||hidden text|| as MD_SPAN_SPOILER only when MD_FLAG_SPOILERS is enabled.
md_html forwards parser_flags into MD_PARSER, installs the span callbacks, and calls md_parse on the supplied Markdown bytes.
For ordinary text, the after-source path processes document blocks, analyzes inline marks, and processes the resolved spans.

evidence.dependency_reason: Document processing invokes processing of all collected blocks.
The leaf-block default path invokes normal block-content processing.
Normal block-content processing invokes inline analysis and then inline rendering.

facts.statement: The supplied recipe compiles the fuzz entry and links it with the HTML renderer and parser static libraries.

evidence.dependency_reason: These are the target's build and link commands.

facts.statement: With the spoiler flag, the after-source marks pipe characters, collects each || as one potential delimiter, pairs the delimiters, and emits spoiler span callbacks for resolved pairs.

evidence.dependency_reason: The spoiler flag enables pipe scanning.
The collector creates two-character pipe marks.
Inline analysis sends unresolved two-character pipe marks to md_analyze_pipe.
md_analyze_pipe resolves a closer with a preceding opener.
Resolved two-character pipe marks dispatch MD_SPAN_SPOILER callbacks.

facts.statement: The after-source HTML callbacks render opening <x-spoiler> and closing </x-spoiler> tags.
The entry's output callback discards rendered text, and the entry discards md_html's return value. It contains no explicit assertion or output check.
The before-source span enum ended at MD_SPAN_U, and its pipe collector handled pipes as single table or wiki-link marks. These facts concern the before-source units only.

evidence.dependency_reason: The before collector creates single-character pipe marks only for table or wiki-link handling.

facts.statement: The HTML opening callback suppresses nested tags while processing an image label, so tag emission depends on span context.

evidence.dependency_reason: The image-nesting guard returns before the spoiler-tag switch case.
